reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V1 (their declared best): V0 yaw_rate_pred_rads minus per-segment mean residual on straight samples (|delta_road|<0.01) within v>2.0, reproducing the run_ladder.py V1 branch.
notes: Reconstructed agent's favourite V1 = V0 (CSV yaw_rate_pred_rads) minus per-segment mean residual on straight samples (|delta_road|<0.01, v>2.0). Agent originally scored Mach-E only (306 segs); extended to all 545 canonical Ford segments (521 contained samples after v>2.0 filter). Bias correction is per-segment (1 DOF/seg) computed in-script from straight samples in each segment; no fitted parameters file required. Segments lacking straight samples fall back to bias=0 (i.e. V0).
